results.headline: Bangladesh journalists jailed since 2024 remain detained as BNP fails to honour press-freedom pledge

results.headline: Taiwan parliament passes its own drone plan and backs $7bn boost for domestic builders
results.reason: why_it_matters: asserts 'this summer's typhoons and record heat are already disrupting Taiwan Strait military planning and readiness,' but the cited source (A497) only discusses how such weather 'could undermine' or 'can disrupt' readiness, not that it already has.

results.headline: Trump chip tariff plan could cost $90bn in annual GDP and delay one-fifth of US data centre projects, industry warns
results.reason: summary: claims the tariffs would 'delay or cancel most data centre projects planned through 2030,' but the cited source (A47) states the CCIA estimate is about 20 percent (one-fifth) of such projects delayed or canceled -- matching the headline's 'one-fifth' figure but directly contradicting the summary's 'most.'

results.headline: Fed chair Warsh's Jackson Hole debut scrutinised for rate signals as inflation persists above target
results.reason: summary: names 'Michelle Bowman, Christopher Waller and Lisa Cook' as the dissenting governors, but the cited source (A29) states only 'three of them dissenting in favour of a hike' without naming any governor.

results.headline: Japan's births rise for first time in 11 years
results.reason: summary: gives specific figures ('731,000 babies born, a 1.8 percent increase') and attributes the rise to 'a post-pandemic rebound in marriages,' none of which appear in the only cited source (A289), whose available text is merely a repeated headline with no supporting detail.
